plainTranslation: Composite Pluto in the 4 House: With Composite Pluto in the 4th house, you may struggle over power and control of the foundation of the relationship, and emotions can run high between you. You can get into epic battles at times, and need to be more considerate of what each other is feeling. In a family relationship, you may have great difficulties, and one of you can be more controlling. You have the ability to create deep change in one another with this placement.
policy: Composite chart entries describe the relationship as a third entity. Read alongside synastry; do not use as a verdict on whether a relationship should continue.
note: Imported from The Dark Pixie Astrology composites material text.
